name: @kaus-io/dsh-android-studio
description: Android Studio for DSH: the resident Android workbench (ADB, run/build/sign, task output) plus an IDE-grade code reader for Sidebar document previews

scripts.build: pnpm run build:tools && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:tools: esbuild build-host.ts build-client.ts smoke.ts scripts/check-versions.ts scripts/dist-tag.ts tests/check-versions.test.ts tests/dist-tag.test.ts tests/reader-engine.test.ts tests/reader-robustness.test.ts action.test.ts android.test.ts card-model.test.ts client-contract.test.ts index.test.ts observe.test.ts popup-model.test.ts runner.test.ts sign.test.ts ui-model.test.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --outdir=. --outbase=. --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build:tools && pnpm run build:host && node --test *.test.mjs tests/*.test.mjs && node smoke.mjs
